DISTRIBUTION OF WATER BOWLS 
 
Name of Activity : Distribution of water bowls to the NSS volunteers 
 
Need of the Activity : To motivate NSS volunteers and students towards the service for 
voiceless in summer season. 
NSS Unit in association with  SEVA NATUREALS, a non government  organisation in Andhra 
Pradesh and Telengana is conducted distribution of water bowls to the NSS volunteers to serve the  
water to birds in summer season on 18.04.2023. The programme was initiated by principal Dr.N  
Sudhakar Reddy and addressing the volunteers regarding placing the water regularly in water bowls  
and motivate do such kind of things in future. As part of this programme 106 water clay bowls were  
distributed.

WORLD ENVIRONMENT DAY 
 
Name of Activity : WORLD ENVIRONMENT DAY 
 
Need of the Activity : To provide awareness on Environment and its protection.

conducted World’s Environment day -2023 on 05.06.2023. The programme was initiated by Principal  
Dr.N Sudhakar Reddy and addressing the volunteers regarding the plantaion and maintain the

Chandraiah NSS PO of Sri Venkateshwara College of Engineering had taken the session and 
explained about the event and given the awareness on Environment. At last principal and NSS PO’s  
started plantation near the college.

SEED BALL MAKING 
 
Name of Activity : 3 DAYS WORKSHOP ON SEED BALL MAKING 
 
Need of the Activity : To motivate NSS volunteers and students towards increasing the 
plantation by making seed balls and environment sustainability. 
NSS Unit in association with  SEVA NATUREALS, a non government  organisation in Andhra 
Pradesh and Telengana is conducted seed ball making in SV COLLEGE OF ENGINEERING open  
auditorium. Almost 600 students had participated in making of seed balls. It was conducted for 2 days  
and we had prepared 1 lakh seed balls. These were distributed to Vasan eye care hospital and forest  
officers and other institutions they thrower the balls in open areas were the plants didn’t grow. SEVA  
NATUREAL volunteers Sivaji garu had guided the students how to prepare the seed balls.

BLOOD DONATION CAMP 
 
Name of Activity : BLOOD DONATION CAMP 
 
Need of the Activity : To motivate NSS volunteers and students towards donating the blood to 
save lives. 
NSS Unit in association with We Are with You Charitable Trust conducted a blood donation camp

had collected. Refreshments were distributed to all the donors. It was the highest count of blood  
collected compare to previous camps. NSS volunteers and WAY foundation together make the event  
grand success.

Foreword 
 
The NSS Unit of Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering has been trying to follow 
and nurture the ideology of NSS in a manner that ensures meaningful participation of all 
stakeholders. The activities carried out in Seven Day Special NSS Camp- 2024 have served 
as an eye opener for the young NSS volunteers about the contemporary problems that our 
country is facing. The special initiatives, lectures and activities undertaken during the camp 
have served as a milestone in fostering social responsibility and nationalism among young 
NSS volunteers. Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering has always had a strong vision and 
commitment toward the service of the society and its weaker sections. With deep sense of 
gratification, we take pride in the successful completion of the camp by the NSS volunteers of 
the College. Our NSS Unit worked on and off the campus with great enthusiasm and 
zeal.Therearesomeremarkablesocialserviceactivitiesdonebytheunit.Forinstance,plantation 
drives, blood donation camp, generating awareness about Corona virus and waste 
segregation, cleaning of surroundings by NSS volunteers, sensitization programs on 
sanitation, Eye camp, hygiene and cleanliness in adopted village Venkatapuram.The 
insemination of these activities, we believe will go long way in dispersing the seeds of Clean, 
Healthy and Green surroundings throughout the nation through our NSS volunteers. We are 
pledged to social service and to take this initiative beyond the stipulated time frame. The 
principles on which NSS as an organization is built, has inherent characters in line with the 
cause of nation building through service. The activities done by the NSS volunteers during 
the camp helped them to equip themselves with an insight, sensitivity and close 
understanding of the problems that are faced at the grass root level. With the fieldexperiences, 
ourvolunteershavelearnthowtoleadalifeofdignitywithpositivemindsetand contribute to the 
growth of Nation by one or the other way. The enthusiasm which our volunteers put their 
heart in to the NSS initiatives, this learning experience is bound to become movement in itself 
in the times to come. 
We take this  opportunity to express our gratitude to Dr.N.Sudhakar Reddy,  our worthy 
Principal, for his valuable inputs, guidance and support throughout the year. We congratulate  
and extend our best wishes to NSS volunteers, teaching and Non Teaching staff who have  
made this journey a success due to sincere and sustained efforts and for their keen efforts to  
accomplish the targets in the planned activities. 
NSS Unit 
Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering 
Report of NSS Special Camp – 2023-2024 Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering, Tirupati  
 
Seven Days NSS Special Camp,March,2024 
 
 
 
Special Camping forms an integral part of National Service Scheme. It has a special  
appeal to the youth as it provides unique opportunities to the students for group living,  
collective experience sharing and constant interaction with the community. 
 
The primary objectives of the special camping programs are: 
 
 
➢ Making education more relevant to the present situation, to meet the felt needs of 
thecommunitiesandsupplementtheeducationofuniversity/college/schoolstudentsbybringin 
gthem face to face with the prevailing situation of the community. 
 
➢ To provide opportunities for students to play their due roles in the implementation of 
various development programs by planning and executing development projects, 
whichnotonlyhelpincreatingdurablecommunityassetsinruralareasandslumsbutalsoresultin 
the improvement of the condition of weaker sections of the communities. 
 
➢  Encouraging the students and non -student to work along with the adults in rural 
areas, thereby developing their character, social consciousness and commitment, 
discipline and healthy and helpful attitudes towards the community. 
 
➢ Building potential youth leaders by exploring the latent potential among the campers, 
both students as well as local youth (rural and urban), with a view to involve them more  
intimately in development projects for longer periods. The local leadership generated  
during the camps would also be useful in ensuring proper maintenance of the assets  
created as a result of the camps. 
 
➢  Emphasizing the dignity of labor and self -help and the need for combining 
physical work  with intellectual pursuits, and encouraging youth to participate 
enthusiastically in the process of national development, and promote national integration 
through democratic living and cooperative action.

• The inaugural ceremony of Seven days National Service Scheme Special camp commenced with the  
lighting of lamp by the Principal Dr N.Sudhakar Reddy and NSS Unit on 18 -03-2024.The program 
was followed by Saraswati -Vandana.NSS Programme Officer, Dr T.Chandraiah formally welcomed  
all the volunteers from various  departments of the college.  He mentioned about the significance of 
the camp and its aims about bringing together a core group of volunteers with a significant 
participation from their own departments. 
 
• Principal, Dr N.Sudhakar Reddy has described the importance of camp in NSS and related activities  
and how they are interconnected from a long time. He motivated everyone to actively participate in  
the camp to get benefited. 
 
• In the end, Dr T.Chandraiah, NSS Programme Officer offered a vote of thanks to all including Dr S  
Sharadha, NSS Coordinator, JNTU, Anantapur. He thanked all the fifty registered volunteers for  
gracing the occasion by their solemn presence. He also thanked management of S V Colleges for  
providing all kind of facilities to conduct such camp in the adopted village Venkatapuram. 
• Few photographs of the program are attached herewith for kind perusal.

Day 2 –Mega Medical camp –19, March 2024 
Serving food for the volunteers 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• On 19th March, 2024, NSS Unit of Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering has successfully 
completed the event of Mega Medical camp under the National Service Scheme at adopted village  
Venkatapuram. At that time Principal advice to volunteers to think differently for the Society to 
make positive changes and to make improvement. 
• Programme Officer Dr T Chandraiah orients the NSS volunteers by notifying the importance of NSS  
for them as well as society. He shared his past experiences with volunteers that how he got the  
success through NSS and what difficulties he faced while performing his role as Programme Officer.  
He said that “In society all the human beings are comprise equal importance, no matter with the Men  
or Women.” He also said that the dedication is must to accomplish the goals and dreams in life. 
• Dr. S.Murali Krishna, Head, Dept. of IT also addressed the volunteers and passed a message of  
kindness & being helpful to the needy people. After the inspirational words of guests and Principal 

 
we all move towards the place where medical camp took place. Approximately 200 people are 
treated with 23 doctors of eye checkup, dental checkup, ENT and BP, sugar & ECG. At last each and  
every doctor and volunteers had the lunch at the camp.  Hospital faculty distributed free medicals to  
all the people who come for checkup. 
Few photographs of the program are attached herewith for kind perusal.

  20, March 2024

school 
• Event had started at 10:00 AM. He took approximately 1hr of time to teach and 30min to play the

• Pavan a motivational speaker had taught the children how to behave and how to be in school. 
 
• His three main principles are Duty, Dignity, Discipline was taught to the students. And we played  
some motivational videos and moral stories.  He teaches the  children the basic moral values  and 
ethics.

Day 4 – Physical Fitness program followed sports and games– 
  21, March 2024  
 
• On 21st March 2024, NSS Unit of Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering has organized Sports &  
games event at MPP School of adopted village Venkatapurarm. The day was filled with a lot of  
excitement, along with thrills, spirit, and cheers. All the students were very excited about the day, 
and the activities that were going to be carried out throughout the day. 
 
• There were many sports events that were carried out paralleled, which included Musical chairs,  
running race. Also, for children from classes 1 to 4, different games like hopscotch, and lemon spoon  
race were organized. 
 
• All the students were awarded points on the basis of their performance and some other parameters.  
All were happy at the end of the event, and all the efforts of the students paid off. In the prize  
distribution ceremony  (Valedictory), all the winning  students and teams  were awarded  Geometry 
box, crayons and water bottles. In the end, the Headmaster of the school addressed all the students  
and their parents, congratulating all the winning students, and appreciating the efforts taken by each  
student on the day. 
 
Few photographs of the program are attached herewith for kind perusal 

 
 
 
 
Volunteers conducting games for the students 
 

 
Day 5–Hands on practice – Health and hygiene - 
22, March 2023 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• On 22 nd as scheduled NSS volunteers had gather the students and had a sportive talk with students  
how to wash the hands. 
• Every student had washed their hands under the guidance of NSS volunteers. It improves the 
discipline among the students. 
• Also our team explains how to maintain a healthy environment make premises clean and neat and the  
uses of doing the above things. 
• Students had enjoyed the session and they promised that they will maintain the school premises neat  
and clean to maintain a healthy environment and the H.M of the school take the responsibility that he  
will do the things by the students only. 
• Few photographs of the program are attached herewith for kind perusal. 
 
 
 
Volnuteers explaining the students how to wash the hands 
 
 

 
Day 6 – Valedictory-23, March 2024 
Serving food for volunteers 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• On 23rd March 2024, the school class was set and the furniture was arranged for the formal 
valedictory function. Refreshments were served at 11AM. The formal function began at 10:30 AM  
with a prayer followed by a cake cutting. The program was presided by Shri Seshadri garu, 
Headmaster, MPP School, Venkatapuram. 
• The program began with a lecture by NSS PO showcasing all the activities conducted during the  
camp and also delivered the concluding remarks about the NSS Camp. He congratulated and 
appreciated the work done by the volunteers of Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering. He also  
thanked Principal Dr N Sudhakar Reddy and Sarpanch Mrs. M.Susheela for providing good facilities  
for the safe accommodation of the NSS volunteers. 

 
• School staff congratulated all the NSS volunteers and appreciated all the work done by them in High  
School and surrounding area.  Few NSS volunteers shared their experiences during  the camp. This  
was followed by a Prize Distribution Ceremony for the winners of the competitions namely Musical 
chairs, hopscotch, Blow the ball, running race and lemon spoon etc. 
 
• This was followed by the Cultural Program which comprised of classical dance performance. The  
program ended with NSS anthem at12:00PM. Few photographs are attached herewith for your kind  
perusal 
• At last we had the lunch and get back to the college.

Day 7 –Swachh Bharat – Vikasit Bharat- 24, March 2024 
Serving Food for the voulnteers 
 
 
 
 
 
• As a part of Special camp the National Service Scheme (NSS) in collaboration with Swachhta Action 
Plan (SAP) has organized a cleanliness drive on 23 March 2024 at adopted villageVenkatapuram. 
• The main objective of the cleanliness drive was to address the issues of hygiene, public sanitation  
conditions, and to create awareness towards cleanliness inside the village. The program has started at  
10 am with an interactive session with the MPP school teachers, students and villagers regarding the  
need and importance of sanitation and cleanliness in life. 
• Ingrained with the pure spirit of the Swachh Bharat, faculty members has motivated the volunteers to  
keep up the efforts of a clean environment on a personal level. After the interactive session, the  
cleanliness drive starts at 10 am with the help of 50 volunteers of NSS. With the motto of “Swachh  
Bharat”, all  volunteers pick plastic and waste  papers from the premises and dump  them in  the 
garbage bags.
